# railway_environment (Data Source)

A Railway environment: the context a `railway.go` file receives as `railway.Context`, plus its pull request details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_environment" "staging" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Environment ID.

### Read-Only

- `base_environment` (String) Environment a pull request environment was forked from.
- `config_etag` (String) Version of the environment's configuration.
- `is_ephemeral` (Boolean) Whether Railway deletes the environment with its pull request.
- `name` (String) Environment name, as `railway.Context.Environment`.
- `pr_branch` (String) Branch of a pull request environment.
- `pr_number` (Number) Pull request number of a pull request environment.
- `pr_repo` (String) Repository of a pull request environment.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `project_name` (String) Project name.
